name: FileBrowser Quantum
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: FileBrowser Quantum is a web file manager with search, previews, sharing and WebDAV. The egg serves the files folder, with sign-ups closed and an admin account whose password you set.
startup: if [ -z "${FILEBROWSER_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-}" ]; then echo "Set Admin password in the server's settings, then start the server again."; exit 1; fi; exec ./filebrowser -c config.yaml

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# FileBrowser Quantum: downloads FileBrowser Quantum from its GitHub
# releases, checked against GitHub's SHA-256, and writes a first
# config.yaml. The files folder, the database and config.yaml are never
# touched once there.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
    aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
    *) fail "FileBrowser Quantum has no build for this CPU ($(uname -m))." ;;
esac

# Releases are tagged v2.0.2-stable or v2.1.5-beta: a plain 2.0.2 means the
# stable release.
version="${VERSION:-latest}"
if [ "$version" != latest ]; then
    version="v${version#v}"
    [[ $version =~ -[A-Za-z] ]] || version="$version-stable"
fi
tag=$(gh-release tag gtsteffaniak/filebrowser "$version") ||
    fail "Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 2.0.2 or 2.1.5-beta, then reinstall."

if [ -x filebrowser ] && [ "$(cat .filebrowser-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag" ]; then
    echo "FileBrowser Quantum $tag is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading FileBrowser Quantum $tag."
    gh-release download gtsteffaniak/filebrowser "$tag" "linux-$arch-filebrowser" filebrowser.new
    chmod 0755 filebrowser.new
    mv -f filebrowser.new filebrowser
    echo "$tag" > .filebrowser-version
fi

mkdir -p files
if [ ! -f config.yaml ]; then
    cat > config.yaml <<'YAML'
# FileBrowser Quantum's settings:
# https://github.com/gtsteffaniak/filebrowser/wiki/Full-Config-Example
# The port and the admin's name are set by the server's settings. Restart
# the server after changing this file.
http:
  port: 8080
server:
  # No calls to GitHub to look for new versions.
  disableUpdateCheck: true
  cacheDir: .cache
  database:
    path: filebrowser.db
  sources:
    - path: files
      name: Files
auth:
  adminUsername: admin
  methods:
    password:
      enabled: true
      signup: false
YAML
fi
echo "Installed FileBrowser Quantum $tag."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The FileBrowser Quantum version to install, such as 2.0.2 or 2.1.5-beta, or latest. Reinstall to change it.

variables.name: Admin username
variables.description: The name of the admin account.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: The admin account's password, at least 8 characters. It is set again at every start, so change it here.
